chapter: Films, Las Vegas and the union
title: Only two left from the New Orleans film band
summary: Callender notes that he and Charlie Beal are the only survivors of the group in the photo.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I was looking at this picture here from New Orleans, and I see Zuttie Singleton, Kid Ory, Bud Scott,
Louis Armstrong, Barney Bigard, Charlie Beal and myself -- and there's only two of us left out of that bunch.
You and Charlie. Yes. And that was 1947.
